args.text: KU cancelled your outbound KUE08A, so I have refunded the full USD 420 in cash to your card ending 6808. The Delta return DLE08B is different: you cancelled it yourself, and its USD 380 came back as an eCredit, so it is not paid out in cash and I cannot refund it to your card. I have asked Delta whether that eCredit can be paid back in cash; it has not answered yet. Your Lakeside hotel booking LKE08C was already refunded USD 900 to your card on 22 October.

KU dropped the route and cancelled our outbound, so I cancelled the hotel and the Delta return on the last free day. Delta only gave a credit and it's stuck with YOU, which is absurd since it's our money. I want all of it back in cash. lucia.moreno@example.com, card 6808.
